newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines withdraws two-day reverse repos.
newsitem.headline: Philippines withdraws two-day reverse repos.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday it had withdrawn the two-day reverse repos from its over-the-counter facility.
The two-day reverse repos were offered on Monday with a coupon of 10.0 percent.
The bank also closed its overnight borrowing and lending instruments after it squared off its position in early trade on Tuesday, a bank official said.
Earlier in the day, the bank offered its overnight repos and reverse repos at 12.75 percent and 10.0 percent, respectively.
The one-month and two-month reverse repos were kept unchanged at 10.0 percent, while the 351-day special series Treasury bills were also untouched at 10.4 percent.
